# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Jul 24, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on July 24, 2026, focused heavily on stabilizing cloud infrastructure, improving provisioning worker reliability, and integrating the LP3 demo UI stack. Key efforts included hardening replacement-cleanup reconcilers, fixing authentication session recovery, and enhancing cross-platform diagnostic tooling.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

*   **Cloud Infrastructure & Provisioning Stability**
    *   Hardened the replacement-cleanup reconciler to prevent premature deletion of agents during cutover ([#17160](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17160), [#17159](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17159)).
    *   Resolved provisioning worker heap aborts and improved CAS precision for image rollouts ([#17156](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17156), [#17155](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17155), [#17153](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17153), [#17152](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17152)).
    *   Backported canonical Bun pinning for image canary workflows ([#17148](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17148)).

*   **UI, Auth, and LP3 Integration**
    *   Integrated the LP3 demo UI stack, featuring durable chat outcomes, retry/cancel correlation, and improved tool-envelope suppression ([#17151](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17151)).
    *   Fixed native session recovery to ensure stale bearers are correctly advanced to the auth gate ([#17161](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17161)).

*   **Tooling & Diagnostics**
    *   Implemented and diagnosed cross-platform capture tools to support evidence-based development ([#17015](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17015)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
*   [#17157](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17157): fix(ops): schedule runner-workspace prune via a committed systemd system timer.

## CLOSED ISSUES
*   None.

*   None.
